# CommandPalette

A command palette: a search field with a list of pages and actions to jump to or run, usually opened with
`Mod+K` (register it with useHotkeys). Matching is fuzzy and every word of the query must match; results of the
same group stay together; an optional `onSearch` adds results from a server.

**Interaction**: when it opens, focus is in the search field. `↑` / `↓` move the current result (also on
hover), `Enter` runs it and `Esc` closes the palette; focus then returns to the element that was focused
before. Keys pressed while an input method is composing text are left to the input method. Beyond `limit`
results, a line below the list says how many more there are. The key hints at the bottom use Kbd; the keys of
the palette are registered with useHotkeys in the `commandPalette` scope, so shortcut help can list them.

**Category**: Patterns · **Common uses**: Global search and jump (`Mod+K`), running actions by name, finding people and files

## Import

```ts
import { CommandPalette } from 'vellum-ui'
```

## Basic usage

Open it with the button or `Mod+K` (registered with useHotkeys), type to filter, `↑` / `↓` and `Enter` to run.
Matching is fuzzy: "nwp" finds "New project". HotkeysProvider keeps the `Mod+K` of this example from clashing
with the one of the page that shows it.

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import {
  Button,
  CommandPalette,
  type CommandPaletteItem,
  HotkeysProvider,
  Inline,
  Kbd,
  Text,
  useHotkeys,
} from 'vellum-ui'

const items: CommandPaletteItem[] = [
  { id: 'home', title: 'Home', group: 'Pages', icon: 'home' },
  { id: 'projects', title: 'Projects', group: 'Pages', icon: 'project', keywords: ['work'] },
  {
    id: 'files',
    title: 'Files',
    group: 'Pages',
    icon: 'folder',
    keywords: ['assets', 'documents'],
  },
  {
    id: 'settings',
    title: 'Settings',
    group: 'Pages',
    icon: 'settings',
    keywords: ['preferences'],
  },
  {
    id: 'new-project',
    title: 'New project',
    group: 'Actions',
    icon: 'plus',
    shortcut: 'mod+alt+n',
  },
  { id: 'invite', title: 'Invite a member', group: 'Actions', icon: 'users' },
  {
    id: 'theme',
    title: 'Switch to dark mode',
    group: 'Actions',
    icon: 'moon',
    keywords: ['theme'],
  },
]

function Palette() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
  const [last, setLast] = useState('Nothing yet')
  // Mod+K opens and closes the palette, also from inside text fields
  useHotkeys('mod+k', () => setOpen((o) => !o), {
    description: 'Search and jump',
    allowInInputs: true,
  })
  return (
    <Inline gap={3} align="center">
      <Button onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>
        Search <Kbd keys="mod+k" />
      </Button>
      <Text size="sm" tone="secondary">
        Last run: {last}
      </Text>
      <CommandPalette
        open={open}
        onOpenChange={setOpen}
        items={items.map((item) => ({ ...item, onSelect: () => setLast(item.title) }))}
      />
    </Inline>
  )
}

export function Basic() {
  return (
    <HotkeysProvider>
      <Palette />
    </HotkeysProvider>
  )
}
```

## States

### Many results

At most `limit` results (50 by default) are shown; a line below the list says how many more there are.

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { Button, CommandPalette, type CommandPaletteItem, HotkeysProvider } from 'vellum-ui'

const many: CommandPaletteItem[] = Array.from({ length: 120 }, (_, i) => ({
  id: `file-${i + 1}`,
  title: `Report ${String(i + 1).padStart(3, '0')}.pdf`,
  group: 'Files',
  icon: 'file-text',
}))

function ManyPalette() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
  return (
    <>
      <Button onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>Open 120 files</Button>
      <CommandPalette open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen} items={many} emptyText="No files found" />
    </>
  )
}

export function ManyResults() {
  return (
    <HotkeysProvider>
      <ManyPalette />
    </HotkeysProvider>
  )
}
```

## Advanced

### Searching a server

`onSearch` adds results from a server after the local matches. It is called when typing stops, and the
signal is aborted when the query changes; "Searching" appears only when the search takes a while.

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { Button, CommandPalette, type CommandPaletteItem, HotkeysProvider } from 'vellum-ui'

const items: CommandPaletteItem[] = [
  { id: 'home', title: 'Home', group: 'Pages', icon: 'home' },
  { id: 'projects', title: 'Projects', group: 'Pages', icon: 'project', keywords: ['work'] },
  {
    id: 'files',
    title: 'Files',
    group: 'Pages',
    icon: 'folder',
    keywords: ['assets', 'documents'],
  },
  {
    id: 'settings',
    title: 'Settings',
    group: 'Pages',
    icon: 'settings',
    keywords: ['preferences'],
  },
  {
    id: 'new-project',
    title: 'New project',
    group: 'Actions',
    icon: 'plus',
    shortcut: 'mod+alt+n',
  },
  { id: 'invite', title: 'Invite a member', group: 'Actions', icon: 'users' },
  {
    id: 'theme',
    title: 'Switch to dark mode',
    group: 'Actions',
    icon: 'moon',
    keywords: ['theme'],
  },
]

const people = ['Alex Kim', 'Maria Garcia', 'Sam Lee', 'Noah Brown', 'Emma Wilson']

function searchPeople(query: string, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<CommandPaletteItem[]> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      const q = query.toLowerCase()
      resolve(
        people
          .filter((name) => name.toLowerCase().includes(q))
          .map((name) => ({ id: `person:${name}`, title: name, group: 'People', icon: 'user' })),
      )
    }, 400)
    signal.addEventListener('abort', () => {
      clearTimeout(timer)
      reject(new DOMException('Aborted', 'AbortError'))
    })
  })
}

function AsyncPalette() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
  return (
    <>
      <Button onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>Find people</Button>
      <CommandPalette
        open={open}
        onOpenChange={setOpen}
        items={items}
        onSearch={searchPeople}
        placeholder="Search pages, actions and people"
      />
    </>
  )
}

export function AsyncSearch() {
  return (
    <HotkeysProvider>
      <AsyncPalette />
    </HotkeysProvider>
  )
}
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `open` | `boolean` | Whether the palette is open. | — | Yes |
| `onOpenChange` | `(open: boolean) => void` | Called when the palette asks to open or close (`Esc`, clicking outside, running an item). | — | Yes |
| `items` | `readonly CommandPaletteItem[]` | The items, matched locally while typing (see matchCommands). | — | Yes |
| `onSearch` | `(query: string, signal: AbortSignal) => Promise<readonly CommandPaletteItem[]>` | Searches more items for a query, such as people or files on a server. Called 150 ms after typing stops; the signal is aborted when the query changes or the palette closes. The results are shown after the local matches, as they are (not matched again). | — | No |
| `placeholder` | `string` | Placeholder of the search field, "Search or run a command" by default (follows `locale`). | — | No |
| `emptyText` | `string` | Text shown when nothing matches, "No results" by default (follows `locale`). | — | No |
| `label` | `string` | Accessible name of the dialog and the search field, "Command palette" by default (follows `locale`). | — | No |
| `limit` | `number` | Largest number of results shown; beyond it, a line below the list says how many more there are. | `50` | No |

Also accepts `testId` (rendered as `data-testid`), `aria-label`, `role` and `id`, like all primitives.

Does not accept `style` or `className`: appearance is adjusted only through the semantic props above and the theme.

## Types

Types of this library used above. Import them with `import type { … } from 'vellum-ui'`.

### CommandPaletteItem

An item of a CommandPalette: a page to go to or an action to run.

| Field | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | Unique id. | — | Yes |
| `title` | `string` | Title, shown and matched first. | — | Yes |
| `group` | `string` | Group shown at the end of the row, such as "Pages" or "Actions"; items of a group are kept together. | — | No |
| `icon` | `IconName` | Icon at the start of the row. | — | No |
| `keywords` | `readonly string[]` | Extra words that also match, such as synonyms or an English name. | — | No |
| `shortcut` | `string \| readonly string[]` | Shortcut hint shown with Kbd, such as `'mod+n'`. | — | No |
| `onSelect` | `() => void` | Runs the item; the palette closes first. | — | No |

### IconName

Name of a registered icon. Only the icons listed here can be used; they are Lucide icons under shorter names
(`trash` is Lucide's `Trash2`, `more` is `Ellipsis`). All names at runtime: `iconNames`.

126 values, listed on the [Icon](Icon.md#types) page.
